text:
maria: heads-up — staging embeddings canary threw a bunch of 503s around 23:12 UTC. suspect kv-cache edge case. opening hotfix window, need expedited approval to push to prod within ~30m. Deploy-bot created branch `hotfix/embeds-kv-leak-v2026.2` and a release candidate image.
aj: pinging infra — what are rollback criteria if prod shows errors? we should define a clear metric (p50/p95 error rate) and a quick revert path.
liz-oncall: saw p95 tail spike to 1.2s and a few 503s. traffic is ~5% of prod due to canary. If errors >1% over 5m, we should rollback.
sanjay: can we get a short release note and smoke test checklist? I need that to sign off with support on standby.
release_manager: list of things I need to approve: (1) short release note, (2) smoke tests + playbook, (3) rollback tag and who will execute. Also prefer pinning to exact image digest.
opsbot: ci/status — Build: ✅, Unit tests: ✅, Integration: flaky (2 failures) — retriggered. Canary smoke: in progress.
deploy-bot: canary deploy to eu-west1 started. image: redwood/embeds:v2026.2@sha256:abcdef123456. health checks passing for first 10 instances. will hold at 5% traffic for 10m.
maria: release notes (draft):
```
- Fix: embeddings kv-cache double-free on short sequence inference causing intermittent 503s
- Impact: small subset of embeddings workloads after long-lived KV usage
- Risk: low-to-moderate (changes cache path). Rolling back to v2026.1 restores previous behavior.
```
aj: rollback plan: revert to image `redwood/embeds:v2026.1@sha256:111111aaa` via `kubectl set image` on the deployment; ops will run rollout undo and monitor /metrics error_rate and request_latency. rollback owner: @aj.
release_manager: smoke checklist:
- run `smoke/embeds_basic` locally against canary (pass)
- ramp to 20% internally for 5m
- validate error_rate < 0.5% and p95 < 300ms
If all good, I approve expedited push to prod. If not, rollback immediately.
liz-oncall: support channel alerted and standby. I give preliminary ok to proceed to prod canary if deploy-bot finishes smoke OK.
sanjay: +1 on pinning digest. add short note to release page and slack release thread.
opsbot: canary smoke: ✅ basic inference passes, ✅ latency within expected, error_rate 0.12% over 6m.
deploy-bot: promoted to prod canary at 5% in us-west1 and eu-west1. continuing monitor.
maria: approving expedited rollout based on canary signals. Requesting release_manager final sign-off.
release_manager: signed — expedited approval granted. Release notes added to the release doc and changelog.
aj: assigning rollback watch: I'll be ready to execute if error_rate >1% sustained for 5m or if any 5xx spike >0.5%.
maria: thanks everyone. tagging final steps: @deploy-bot please record rollout in release log and set auto-fallback to v2026.1 for 15m window.
deploy-bot: done — rollout logged, auto-fallback rule set (15m), alerts wired to #incidents and @liz-oncall.
liz-oncall: monitoring live. will update if anything changes. :eyes:
maria: closing thread — hotfix promoted to prod canary and approved for full rollout if no regressions in 30m. :rocket:
